name: Lepirudin
half_life_text: Approximately 1.3 hours

name: Etanercept
half_life_text: 102 +/- 30 hrs in individuals with rheumatoid arthritis and 68 hours in healthy adults

name: Bivalirudin
half_life_text: Normal renal function: 25 min. Creatinine clearance 10-29mL/min: 57min. Dialysis-dependant patients: 3.5h

name: Peginterferon alfa-2a
half_life_text: Terminal half life is 80 hours (range 50 to 140 hours).

name: Thyrotropin Alfa
half_life_text: 25 ± 10 hours

name: Desmopressin
half_life_text: Oral t<sub>1/2</sub>=1.5-2.5 hours. Intranasal t<sub>1/2</sub>=3.3-3.5 hours. IV t<sub>1/2</sub> is biphasic: initial t<sub>1/2</sub>=7.8 minutes, terminal t<sub>1/2</sub>=0.4-4 hours.

name: Palifermin
half_life_text: Elimination half-life: 4.5 hours (range: 3.3-5.7 hours)

name: Aldesleukin
half_life_text: 13 min-85 min

name: Lutropin alfa
half_life_text: Biphasic; terminal half-life is approximately 18 hours.

name: Adalimumab
half_life_text: 10-20 days.

name: Abciximab
half_life_text: Following intravenous bolus administration, free plasma concentrations of Abciximab decrease rapidly with an initial half-life of less than 10 minutes and a second phase half-life of about 30 minutes, probably related to rapid binding to the platelet GPIIb/IIIa receptors.

name: Follitropin beta
half_life_text: Circulation half life of 3-4 hours, elimination half life of 35-40 hours

name: Daptomycin
half_life_text: Half-life elimination: 8-9 hours (up to 28 hours in renal impairment)

name: Cyclosporine
half_life_text: Biphasic and variable, approximately 7 hours (range 7 to 19 hours) in children and approximately 19 hours (range 10 to 27 hours) in adults.

name: Choriogonadotropin alfa
half_life_text: The mean terminal half-life is about 29 ± 6 hours (initial half-life is 4.5 ± 0.5 hours).

name: Abarelix
half_life_text: 13.2 ± 3.2 days

name: Fluvoxamine
half_life_text: 15.6 hours

name: Valsartan
half_life_text: The initial phase t<sub>1/2 α</sub> is < 1 hour while the terminal phase t<sub>1/2 β</sub> is 5-9 hours.
